name: SRES DevPod
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'command -v jj >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; if [ -d .git ] && [ ! -d .jj ]; then jj git init --colocate; fi; if [ -z "$(jj config get user.name 2>/dev/null)" ] && name=$(git config user.name 2>/dev/null); then jj config set --user user.name "$name"; fi; if [ -z "$(jj config get user.email 2>/dev/null)" ] && email=$(git config user.email 2>/dev/null); then jj config set --user user.email "$email"; fi'
